subsystems.label: PWA
subsystems.source_assessment: Current main contains one separately installable Zero/Go/Hub PWA, distinct from apps/web and native mobile. The PWA client exposes only same-origin, no-store GET projections with a returned company_id check; its bounded working set is memory-only and partitions by company, actor, device, surface, audience, context revision and session revision. It has no authenticated session bootstrap or conversation POST/event transport. The merged Workforce host now exposes an authenticated conversation endpoint, but that path is not wired into this PWA; the host contract is currently commissioned only for Zero. The service worker caches the public shell only; no durable private database, encrypted evidence staging or governed command outbox/replay exists in the PWA.
missing_requirements: Integrate server-verified current session/company context with the hosted projection and conversation contracts; extend the PWA beyond read-only GETs to real event transport, reconnect/cancel and explicit unavailable states; implement bounded encrypted private offline storage and governed replay with server revalidation. The external Sites v39/source commit 1d27bd6c4309881244fe412bcf5b5ca63bd4f344 remains metadata-only here, and physical-browser/hosted production certification is outstanding.

test_evidence.scope: Deployed/physical subsystem acceptance is not certified by this source snapshot. Local test executions are recorded in the append-only refresh history; they do not establish production runtime or live-host readiness.

subsystems.label: Native mobile
subsystems.source_assessment: The client recognizes zero/go/hub, but TitanSession carries company/actor/device/surface without session_id or context_revision. Its conversation request is a Future<Map> returning completed items and omits the hosted contract required interaction_id, client_message_id and session_id; it has no event-stream parser, continuation action/token or cancellation API. It expects an items array and authority_neutral response flag, while the current host returns schema_version plus events and no such flag. The host requires an authenticated session whose company, actor, device, surface, session and context_revision match exactly. The mobile test fake returns rev-13 after a rev-12 request and the client accepts it because it checks only that the response revision is nonempty. The host can serialize a completed dispatch result as JSON or SSE, but its SSE writer runs after awaited dispatch and Last-Event-ID filters that completed event array; this is not incremental delivery or reconnectable event-log replay. The hosted runtime currently rejects Go/Hub. The shell keeps the user text and displays one generic reachability/sign-in error. A separate offline command replay service/planner exists and requires server revalidation, but it is not conversation replay or evidence of client integration. Release certification code validates evidence fields; no signed physical-device result is established here.
missing_requirements: Align the native adapter with the authenticated host DTO: include required session, interaction and client-message identity from the verified session; require exact context revision; consume events instead of items; and support true incremental delivery, durable event replay/resume and explicit cancel. Add a server-owned Go/Hub contract before claiming all three hosted modes. Wire logout/company/context revision rotation to clearing cached projections and queued private work, connect offline replay to current server revalidation, and map auth/stale/unconfigured/unavailable/cancel states distinctly. Physical signed iOS/Android Zero/Go/Hub certification remains unrun. #1182/#1188 owns client continuity; #302/#1183 identity and #1049/#1204 SDK work are separate owner lanes.

subsystems.label: DirectAdmin Business Node
subsystems.source_assessment: Current main contains a loopback-only, read-only DirectAdmin health bridge plus an optional Workforce gateway mount. The mount stays unavailable without operator configuration; the Workforce owner currently projects canonical worker/work/run data and rejects lifecycle mutations. The host contract requires the #1049 SDK bridge and #302 current-session exchange for DirectAdmin company switch/revocation; those integration requirements are not established by the bounded health bridge. No live DirectAdmin install, update, recovery or production endpoint is evidenced.
missing_requirements: Complete the #1049/#302 DirectAdmin-to-Workforce authenticated session and role-checked action integration, then execute the operator suite and disposable/live-host install, update, rollback and recovery acceptance. Loopback health observations do not prove production business outcomes.

subsystems.label: Workforce
subsystems.source_assessment: Current main, including merged #811/#1201, contains a hosted runtime composed over durable SQLite run/work stores, cryptographically verified Workforce credentials, current identity-session resolution, company/session/context-revision binding, idempotent request/recovery, continuation and cancellation paths. POST /v1/workforce/conversations supports JSON and SSE and projects a bounded public event set. The server waits for dispatch/recovery/cancel to finish before writing the response; SSE and Last-Event-ID only serialize/filter the completed event array, not live incremental delivery or durable event-log replay. The hosted Workforce contract currently commissions the Zero surface; Go/Hub are rejected pending their authority-aware dispatcher. Code and local/CI tests establish implementation-level behavior, not a live commissioned host, production credential/provider operation or reboot/backup acceptance.
missing_requirements: Run the clean-host commissioning, exact artifact/hash, real credential/provider, reboot/update/rollback and recovery acceptance in docs/operations/workforce-clean-host-acceptance.md. Deliver actual incremental stream and durable event resume plus broader mobile lifecycle under #1182; keep the host runtime at Zero-only until Go/Hub have their own authority-aware contract. Production/live-host and physical-client evidence remains outstanding.
